decisionReason: The repository declares CC0, but the detailed line-ups appear to be generated from third-party football sites (worldfootball.net match reports via yorobot/worldfootball, plus a football-data.org API cache). Those providers' rights and terms are not established, so commercial redistribution rights for the line-up data are not sufficiently established.

provenanceEvidence.fact: workflow 'Update datasets (full versions w/ lineups, etc.)'
'World & Co via wfb', 'add wfb upstream', wfb tool from ../worldfootball
BASE_URL = 'https://www.worldfootball.net'; downloads schedule and match report pages into a web cache
fbdat = football-data.org API responses (crests.football-data.org, match status codes)

notVerifiable: The terms of use of worldfootball.net and football-data.org could not be read from the audit environment (hosts not reachable).
No statement in the openfootball repository names the origin of the line-ups.

parserReconciliation.note: Aggregates only; no player-level data are published.
parserReconciliation.independentCheck: OpenFootballBase data-1.24.6 match_goal / match_lineup / match_card tables (built from the same file by a different parser): 380 matches, 11953 line-up rows, goals 896 + 104 penalties + 24 own goals, yellow 1652, red 69 — identical.
parserReconciliation.scoreCheck: sum of scorers = sum of scores (1024) in every match

identityAudit.registry: 2025/26 LaLiga squad listings with Wikidata QIDs (OpenFootballBase data-1.24.6, from dated Wikipedia revisions): 565 players, 20 clubs mapped by fixture alignment (>= 36/38 matches)
identityAudit.crossCheck: Against the QIDs OpenFootballBase attaches to the same line-ups: 480 player-club pairs found by both, appearance counts identical in 480/480; 53 pairs only in OpenFootballBase (it matches more loosely), 2 only in LANOVA.
